title: RAIN HITS THE GROUND
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program (item 9, atmosphere), in the gritty grounded look he picked. Rain was one sheet of thin lines over the screen that fell on nothing. Now small splash rings open and fade on the ground all across the view, about 50 at a time in rain and 80 in a storm (fewer on Effects LOW), and a second fainter layer of rain falls behind the first so the rain has depth. Both sit under the fog of war, fade in and out as the weather turns, are damped at night like the rain already is, and nothing is drawn in a clear sky. Every splash spot comes from the raid clock, so nothing random is drawn. Drawing only.
now: Rain splashes on the ground and falls in two layers.
